notes: The focal query is now restricted to exactly the assigned complete route CONVERSATION->WORKSPACE->WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP (channels->teams->user_teams, filtered to role='admin'), satisfying the route-identity check; this alone is true for every channel in the single workspace since it only asserts that an admin exists in that workspace. The three participant alternatives (channel member, message author, reaction contributor) named in the binding_note are represented as auxiliary queries, each independently and correlatedly joining channels directly to the participant table and on to users/user_teams with the same admin-role filter, so each auxiliary by itself already ties the admin to that specific channel. Per the union-of-eligible-alternatives instruction for underspecified/disjunctive connection types, the effective match set is the union of channels satisfying the focal-route admin-existence condition together with any one of the three correlated participant auxiliaries, which recomputes to exactly the three intended channels (general, random, engineering) touched by admin Robert Walsh as member/author, while Morgan Freeman (admin, no participation) and the namesake Robert Chen's plain-member channels (growth, project-alpha-dev, core-infra, model-research, product-growth, frontend) remain excluded since no admin appears as a direct participant in them. No seed edits were required; all designed facts were already present in the base seed. All match/negative channels are public, non-DM, non-archived channels in the single workspace, so ordinary conversations.list/history/members/reactions.get access suffices for solver discovery without extra memberships.
